parsed.rationale: Both participating records have is_test=true: `MockDiscogsEntityResolver.resolveArtist` in `Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/DiscogsMarkupParserTests.swift` (package: Metadata) and `MockDiscogsEntityResolver.resolveRelease` in `WXYC/iOS/Tests/WXYCTests/DiscogsFormatterTests.swift` (package: app:iOS). Although the Jaccard similarity is 0.714, the two methods resolve structurally distinct entity types (`Artist` vs `Release`) within their respective test-only mock implementations, making any generic parameterization a test-infrastructure change of marginal value. Collapsing them into a single generic function would couple two otherwise independent test packages and obscure the domain intent of each mock.
